description: Varied nominal plant + varied fault onset + continuous fault severity, calibrated for prompt v3.1 (T_sp fixed at 310 K)
source: outputs/cstr_calibration/20260928_142020_v31_moves (no LLM; 10 random plants per severity; 20 empirical v3.1 first-proposal moves of Qwen2.5-3B per episode, relative to each episode's own setpoints)
rule: the model's first proposals should pass in roughly 25-40% of episodes overall, so that an ACCEPT decision can be trained and certified; no-change passes in a minority of episodes; a strong feed cut (x0.65 or x0.5) passes almost always, so every fault is fixable
finding: v3.1-like moves pass almost only where no-change also passes (0.72-0.75 of moves); where no-change fails they pass in 0.01-0.15. Severity therefore sets how often the model passes but cannot create passes that need a real correction. Fouling almost never passes at any triggering severity and is kept as a source of hard failures.

expected.note: estimates from the calibration table; checked with the real model on a pilot before the full build

family_sampling: balanced: an equal number of episodes per family in every split

fixed.reason: CAR safety/validation thresholds are absolute (313 K limit, 310 K control target)

observable_in_prompt: L_sp and Fin_sp appear as current setpoints
excluded_episodes: no trigger before SHUTDOWN, or a monitor trigger before fault onset; the slot is redrawn with the same family (scripts/35), so the realised severity distribution is conditional on triggering (mild fouling and mild stuck-closed trigger in 20-50% of plants)
